207:The roster table supports bulk role assignment: row checkboxes allow multi-select, a header checkbox provides select-all/deselect-all (with indeterminate state when partially selected), and a bulk action bar appears when any volunteers are selected.
263:The pre-publish surface is [[apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/-components/judges/rotation-timeline.tsx]] — a coverage grid of heats × lanes where organizers click a cell or "Add" to plan a judge's rotation across heats. Crew heat numbers are not guaranteed to start at 1 (the Heats setup UI has a global starting-heat control, see [[crew#Heats Page]]) and may have gaps, so the timeline keeps two spaces: the grid geometry runs in 1-based **display-index** space while stored rotations and the editor form fields (`startingHeat`) run in **actual heat-number** space. The timeline's `displayToHeatNumber` / `heatNumberToDisplay` maps convert at every boundary — cell clicks and rotation drops convert display→actual before reaching the editor, editor preview cells convert actual→display before matching grid keys, and column headers render actual heat numbers. The editor validates/clamps against the workout's real min/max heat numbers (`minHeat`/`maxHeat`), not a heat count — its zod schema is built per-instance so `startingHeat` is bounded to `[minHeat, maxHeat]`, `startingLane` to the max lane count, and `heatsCount` to the heat range, preventing saves that would expand to zero cells. Heats can also have differing lane counts: coverage is always computed from each heat's own `laneCount` (so the timeline's coverage % matches the RotationOverview), grid cells whose lane exceeds a heat's own lane count render as unavailable (assignments there would be dropped by `expandRotationToAssignments`), and the editor's live preview mirrors `expandRotationToAssignments` exactly — skipping heat-number gaps and cycling shift-right lanes per-heat — via a `heats` prop threaded from the timeline (memoized as `editorHeats` — the editor feeds preview cells back through `onPreviewChange` → `setPreviewCells`, so an inline-built array here closes an infinite re-render loop). [[apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/-components/judges/multi-rotation-editor.tsx]] is the per-judge rotation form (multiple collapsible rotation blocks with live preview); its judge dropdown shows each judge's rotation count for the current workout inline with their name, and a compact two-line "Last:" hint (ending heat number with its scheduled time, then which event it's from on the next line) computed across ALL of the event's workouts — the container derives this `latestAssignmentByJudge` map from the full rotation set, mirroring `expandRotationToAssignments` gap-skipping to find each rotation's true ending heat, ordered by workout trackOrder then ending heat. ## Import CSV Preview

Crew import preview is a private operator workflow for volunteer and heat schedule uploads from CSV or Excel workbooks.

Volunteer imports surface as a modal on [[apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/volunteers.tsx|the Volunteers page]] via [[apps/crew/src/components/crew/volunteer-import-flow.tsx]]. The shared tab UI component lives in [[apps/crew/src/components/crew/crew-import-tabs.tsx]]. [[apps/crew/src/routes/api/crew/import.ts]] accepts private preview uploads, while [[apps/crew/src/lib/crew/imports/preview.ts]] and [[apps/crew/src/server/crew-imports.server.ts]] parse and persist previews without applying rows.

CSV parsing still uses [[apps/crew/src/lib/crew/imports/csv.ts#parseCsv]]. Excel workbook parsing accepts `.xlsx` and `.xlsm` uploads, reads the first worksheet through [[apps/crew/src/lib/crew/imports/xlsx.ts#parseXlsx]], converts shared strings and styled time/date cells into text, and feeds the same tabular parser shape as CSV so column mapping, warning generation, and apply planning remain shared.

To bound decompression on the worker, `parseXlsx` only extracts the workbook parts it reads (workbook metadata, worksheets, shared strings, and styles) and rejects the upload with an `invalid_workbook` error when any entry exceeds 20 MB or the extracted total exceeds 50 MB. Shared-string extraction ignores phonetic furigana (`<rPh>`) runs so only base text becomes cell values.

Volunteer imports carry first-class fields beyond name/email/role so Competition Corner exports auto-map: `phoneCountryCode`, `shirtSize`, ranked `rolePreference1`–`rolePreference3`, plus provenance `sourceExternalId` and `sourceCreatedAt`. [[apps/crew/src/lib/crew/imports/column-mapping.ts]] defines their header aliases and [[apps/crew/src/lib/crew/imports/normalize-volunteer-row.ts]] normalizes each to a trimmed string.
